stem: How did President Bush attempt to complete the mission described above?

options.label: F
options.text: By overthrowing a dictator in North Korea

options.label: G
options.text: By fighting a global war on terrorism

options.label: H
options.text: By offering assistance to refugees escaping genocide

options.label: J
options.text: By supporting the Arab Spring movement

visual_elements:
We are on a mission to make sure that freedom is enduring. We're on a mission to say to the rest of the world, come with us—come with us, stand by our side to defeat the evil-doers who would like to rid the world of freedom as we know it.

—President George W. Bush, September 26, 2001
